decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster was launched only in 2023 and fits the firm's coolant and chip management portfolio, so its prospects are still uncertain and keeping it on the website costs little, which favors holding the option open.
The cleaning centrifuge is a more specialized and capital-intensive item, but one year of website presence reveals too little about its value to justify abandoning it while upkeep costs stay low.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost complementary accessory that supports the other coolant products, so the option is cheap to keep and its prospects remain open.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard part of machine tool equipment, so this option costs little to maintain and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The magnetic belt conveyor rounds out the chip conveyor family at low incremental cost, and its uncertainty has not resolved after one year, so it is worth holding.
Hinged belt conveyors are a core, widely demanded variant that shares production with the other conveyors, so keeping it on the market is cheap and still valuable.
